AI.result: 知识独立性强烈预测颠覆性，并介导了小型、现场和新组建团队的颠覆性优势。知识独立性的长期下降为颠覆性的平行下降提供了一种机制性解释。知识独立性推动了颠覆性与影响力之间持久的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现揭示了一个普遍规律：知识独立性催生颠覆性但限制认可。
AI.translation: 尽管对科学颠覆性进行了广泛研究，但仍存在两个问题：为什么在知识日益增长的情况下颠覆性却下降了？为什么颠覆性工作获得的引用更少且更慢？解决这些问题的一种方法是确定一种可靠预测颠覆性并解释这两种模式的内在、论文层面的属性。在此，我们提出了一种新的衡量指标——知识独立性，用于衡量一篇论文在多大程度上引用了相互之间没有引用的参考文献。通过分析1.14亿份出版物，我们发现知识独立性强烈预测颠覆性，并介导了小型、现场和新组建团队的颠覆性优势。其长期下降（无法通过零模型重现）为颠覆性的平行下降提供了一种机制性解释。因果和模拟证据进一步表明，知识独立性推动了颠覆性与影响力之间持久的权衡。总而言之，这些发现填补了理解科学创新的关键空白，揭示了一个普遍规律：知识独立性催生颠覆性但限制认可。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种新的论文层面指标——知识独立性，用于解释科学颠覆性下降以及颠覆性工作认可度低的问题。知识独立性衡量论文引用互不引用的参考文献的程度。通过分析1.14亿份出版物，研究发现知识独立性强烈预测颠覆性，其长期下降是颠覆性衰退的机制性解释。研究揭示了一个普遍的权衡：知识独立性催生颠覆性，但限制了其认可度。
AI.keywords: 知识独立性, 颠覆性, 认可度, 科学创新, 引用权衡
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了“知识独立性”这一新颖的、内在的论文层面指标，它有效地解释了科学颠覆性下降和颠覆性作品认可度受限这两个长期未解的问题。研究通过对1.14亿份出版物进行大规模数据分析，揭示了知识独立性作为颠覆性的强预测因子，并提供了一种机制性解释来解释科学颠覆性的普遍衰退。最终，研究揭示了一个普遍规律，即在颠覆性（创新）和认可度（影响力）之间存在持久的权衡。

title: Benchmarking data encoding methods in Quantum Machine Learning
comments: 30 pages, accepted at the QUEST-IS'25 conference
summary: Data encoding plays a fundamental and distinctive role in Quantum Machine Learning (QML). While classical approaches process data directly as vectors, QML may require transforming classical data into quantum states through encoding circuits, known as quantum feature maps or quantum embeddings. This step leverages the inherently high-dimensional and non-linear nature of Hilbert space, enabling more efficient data separation in complex feature spaces that may be inaccessible to classical methods. This encoding part significantly affects the performance of the QML model, so it is important to choose the right encoding method for the dataset to be encoded. However, this choice is generally arbitrary, since there is no "universal" rule for knowing which encoding to choose based on a specific set of data. There are currently a variety of encoding methods using different quantum logic gates. We studied the most commonly used types of encoding methods and benchmarked them using different datasets.
comment: 30 pages, accepted at the QUEST-IS'25 conference

AI.title_translation: 量子机器学习中数据编码方法的基准测试
AI.tldr: 量子机器学习（QML）中的数据编码至关重要，但缺乏选择规则。本文研究了最常用的编码方法，并使用不同数据集对它们进行了基准测试。
AI.motivation: 数据编码在量子机器学习（QML）中起着基础性作用，它将经典数据转换为量子态，利用希尔伯特空间的高维非线性特性实现高效数据分离。然而，编码方法的选择通常是武断的，因为目前缺乏根据特定数据集选择最佳编码方法的“通用”规则。
AI.method: 研究了目前使用不同量子逻辑门的最常用类型的编码方法，并使用不同的数据集对这些方法进行了基准测试。
AI.translation: 数据编码在量子机器学习（QML）中扮演着基础且独特的角色。虽然经典方法直接将数据作为向量处理，但QML可能需要通过编码电路将经典数据转换为量子态，这些电路被称为量子特征图或量子嵌入。这一步骤利用了希尔伯特空间固有的高维和非线性特性，从而能够在复杂的特征空间中实现更高效的数据分离，而这对于经典方法可能难以企及。编码部分显著影响QML模型的性能，因此为待编码数据集选择正确的编码方法至关重要。然而，这种选择通常是武断的，因为目前还没有“通用”规则来指导基于特定数据集应选择哪种编码。当前存在多种使用不同量子逻辑门的编码方法。我们研究了最常用的编码类型，并使用不同的数据集对它们进行了基准测试。
AI.summary: 本文关注量子机器学习（QML）中至关重要的数据编码问题。QML通过量子特征图将经典数据转换为量子态，利用高维希尔伯特空间实现高效的数据分离。由于编码方法对模型性能影响巨大，但目前缺乏选择编码的通用规则，研究人员通常武断地进行选择。因此，本文对最常用的数据编码方法进行了系统研究，并使用多个数据集对它们进行了基准测试。
AI.keywords: 量子机器学习, 数据编码, 量子特征图, 基准测试, 希尔伯特空间
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于系统地解决了量子机器学习（QML）中的一个核心挑战：数据编码方法的任意性。编码是QML性能的关键瓶颈之一，因为它决定了经典数据如何映射到量子态，从而影响模型利用希尔伯特空间非线性能力进行数据分离的效率。通过对常用编码方法进行基准测试，该研究为研究人员在特定数据集上选择合适的量子特征图提供了急需的经验指导和量化依据，有助于推动QML实际应用的可靠性和性能优化。

title: Structured quantum learning via em algorithm for Boltzmann machines
summary: Quantum Boltzmann machines (QBMs) are generative models with potential advantages in quantum machine learning, yet their training is fundamentally limited by the barren plateau problem, where gradients vanish exponentially with system size. We introduce a quantum version of the em algorithm, an information-geometric generalization of the classical Expectation-Maximization method, which circumvents gradient-based optimization on non-convex functions. Implemented on a semi-quantum restricted Boltzmann machine (sqRBM) -- a hybrid architecture with quantum effects confined to the hidden layer -- our method achieves stable learning and outperforms gradient descent on multiple benchmark datasets. These results establish a structured and scalable alternative to gradient-based training in QML, offering a pathway to mitigate barren plateaus and enhance quantum generative modeling.

AI.title_translation: 基于EM算法的玻尔兹曼机结构化量子学习
AI.tldr: 为了解决QBM的贫瘠高原问题，我们引入了量子EM算法，并在混合架构sqRBM上实施，该方法规避了梯度优化，实现了比梯度下降更稳定和优越的学习性能。
AI.motivation: 量子玻尔兹曼机（QBMs）作为生成模型在量子机器学习中具有潜在优势，但其训练受到“贫瘠高原”问题的根本限制，即梯度随系统尺寸呈指数级消失。
AI.method: 引入了EM算法的量子版本（经典期望最大化方法的信息几何推广），该方法可规避非凸函数上的基于梯度的优化。它在一个混合架构的半量子受限玻尔兹曼机（sqRBM）上实现，其中量子效应仅限于隐藏层。
AI.result: 所提出的方法实现了稳定的学习，并且在多个基准数据集上性能优于梯度下降法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立了一种结构化且可扩展的替代方案，用于量子机器学习（QML）中的基于梯度的训练，为缓解贫瘠高原问题和增强量子生成建模提供了一条途径。
AI.translation: 量子玻尔兹曼机（QBMs）是具有潜在优势的生成模型，但在量子机器学习中，它们的训练从根本上受到贫瘠高原问题的限制，即梯度随系统尺寸呈指数级消失。我们引入了EM算法的量子版本，这是经典期望最大化方法的一种信息几何推广，它规避了非凸函数上的基于梯度的优化。该方法在一个半量子受限玻尔兹曼机（sqRBM）——一种量子效应仅限于隐藏层的混合架构——上实现，实现了稳定的学习，并在多个基准数据集上优于梯度下降法。这些结果为QML中的基于梯度的训练建立了一种结构化且可扩展的替代方案，为缓解贫瘠高原问题和增强量子生成建模提供了途径。
AI.summary: 量子玻尔兹曼机（QBM）的训练受限于梯度消失的贫瘠高原问题。本文提出了一种基于信息几何的量子EM算法，并在半量子受限玻尔兹曼机（sqRBM）上实现。该方法规避了基于梯度的优化，实现了稳定的学习，并在多个基准数据集上超越了梯度下降法，为量子生成建模提供了一种结构化且可扩展的替代方案。
AI.keywords: 量子玻尔兹曼机, EM算法, 贫瘠高原, 半量子受限玻尔兹曼机, 量子生成建模
AI.comments: 本文的主要创新在于提出了一种量子版本的EM算法，将其作为解决量子机器学习中“贫瘠高原”问题的结构化、非梯度优化替代方案。这种方法利用了信息几何的特性来规避非凸函数上的梯度优化，并成功在混合的半量子受限玻尔兹曼机（sqRBM）上得到验证。该工作为提升量子生成模型的稳定性和可扩展性，尤其是缓解量子神经网络扩展中的关键瓶颈——贫瘠高原问题，提供了一条重要的、可行的途径。

title: Diffusion Secant Alignment for Score-Based Density Ratio Estimation
summary: Estimating density ratios has become increasingly important with the recent rise of score-based and diffusion-inspired methods. However, current tangent-based approaches rely on a high-variance learning objective, which leads to unstable training and costly numerical integration during inference. We propose \textit{Interval-annealed Secant Alignment Density Ratio Estimation (ISA-DRE)}, a score-based framework along diffusion interpolants that replaces the instantaneous tangent with its interval integral, the secant, as the learning target. We show theoretically that the secant is a provably lower variance and smoother target for neural approximation, and also a strictly more general representation that contains the tangent as the infinitesimal limit. To make secant learning feasible, we introduce the \textit{Secant Alignment Identity (SAI)} to enforce self consistency between secant and tangent representations, and \textit{Contraction Interval Annealing (CIA)} to ensure stable convergence. Empirically, this stability-first formulation produces high efficiency and accuracy. ISA-DRE achieves comparable or superior results with fewer function evaluations, demonstrating robustness under large distribution discrepancies and effectively mitigating the density-chasm problem.

AI.title_translation: 基于扩散割线对齐的评分密度比估计
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的基于扩散插值和割线对齐的密度比估计框架（ISA-DRE），以解决现有基于切线的方法方差高、训练不稳定和推理成本高的问题。该方法使用割线代替切线作为学习目标，理论上证明了割线的低方差和光滑性，并通过引入割线对齐恒等式（SAI）和收缩区间退火（CIA）技术实现了稳定收敛。实验证明，ISA-DRE在函数评估次数更少的情况下，实现了相当或更优的性能，并在大的分布差异下表现出鲁棒性，有效缓解了密度鸿沟问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于切线的方法在估计密度比时存在高方差、训练不稳定和推理成本高的问题，需要进行数值积分。
AI.method: 提出了一种名为ISA-DRE（Interval-annealed Secant Alignment Density Ratio Estimation）的框架，该框架基于扩散插值，使用割线（区间的积分）代替切线作为学习目标。引入了割线对齐恒等式（SAI）来保证割线和切线表示之间的一致性，并使用收缩区间退火（CIA）来确保训练的稳定收敛。
AI.result: ISA-DRE在函数评估次数更少的情况下，实现了相当或更优的效率和准确性。该方法在大的分布差异下表现出鲁棒性，并有效缓解了密度鸿沟问题。
AI.conclusion: ISA-DRE通过使用割线代替切线作为学习目标，并结合SAI和CIA技术，成功解决了现有方法在密度比估计中的挑战，提供了更稳定、高效和准确的解决方案。
AI.translation: 密度比估计随着最近基于评分和受扩散启发的方法的兴起而变得越来越重要。然而，目前的基于切线的方法依赖于高方差的学习目标，这导致训练不稳定和推理过程中昂贵的数值积分。我们提出了	extit{区间退火割线对齐密度比估计（ISA-DRE）}，一个基于扩散插值的评分框架，它用区间的积分——割线——代替瞬时切线作为学习目标。我们从理论上证明了割线是神经逼近的一个可证明的低方差和更光滑的目标，并且是一个严格更一般的表示，它包含切线作为无穷小极限。为了使割线学习成为可能，我们引入了	extit{割线对齐恒等式（SAI）}来强制割线和切线表示之间的自洽性，以及	extit{收缩区间退火（CIA）}来确保稳定的收敛。在经验上，这种以稳定性为先的公式产生了高效率和准确性。ISA-DRE在函数评估次数更少的情况下实现了相当或更优的结果，在大的分布差异下表现出鲁棒性，并有效缓解了密度鸿沟问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种名为ISA-DRE的新型密度比估计框架，它利用扩散插值和割线对齐方法，解决了传统基于切线方法的高方差和训练不稳定的问题。通过理论分析和实验验证，ISA-DRE在保持低函数评估次数的同时，提高了估计的效率、准确性和鲁棒性，尤其在处理密度鸿沟问题上表现出色。
AI.keywords: 密度比估计, 评分模型, 扩散模型, 割线对齐, 区间退火
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种新颖的ISA-DRE框架，通过用割线取代切线，显著降低了密度比估计的方差，提高了训练稳定性和推理效率。理论分析和实验结果都支持该方法的优越性，尤其是在处理分布差异较大的情况和密度鸿沟问题上。SAI和CIA的引入是该方法成功的关键。

title: Next-Generation Reservoir Computing for Dynamical Inference
summary: We present a simple and scalable implementation of next-generation reservoir computing (NGRC) for modeling dynamical systems from time-series data. The method uses a pseudorandom nonlinear projection of time-delay embedded inputs, allowing the feature-space dimension to be chosen independently of the observation size and offering a flexible alternative to polynomial-based NGRC projections. We demonstrate the approach on benchmark tasks, including attractor reconstruction and bifurcation diagram estimation, using partial and noisy measurements. We further show that small amounts of measurement noise during training act as an effective regularizer, improving long-term autonomous stability compared to standard regression alone. Across all tests, the models remain stable over long rollouts and generalize beyond the training data. The framework offers explicit control of system state during prediction, and these properties make NGRC a natural candidate for applications such as surrogate modeling and digital-twin applications.

AI.title_translation: 下一代储层计算用于动力学推断
AI.tldr: 提出了一种简单且可扩展的下一代储层计算（NGRC）方法，用于从时间序列数据中对动力学系统进行建模。该方法使用时间延迟嵌入输入的伪随机非线性投影，允许特征空间维度独立于观测大小进行选择，为基于多项式的 NGRC 投影提供了一种灵活的替代方案。在吸引子重构和分岔图估计等基准任务上进行了演示，即使在测量不完整和有噪声的情况下也有效。研究还表明，训练过程中的少量测量噪声可以作为有效的正则化器，提高长期自主稳定性。模型在所有测试中都保持稳定，并且能够泛化到训练数据之外。该框架还对系统状态的预测提供了明确的控制，使其成为代理建模和数字孪生等应用的理想选择。
AI.motivation: 需要一种简单且可扩展的方法来从时间序列数据中对动力学系统进行建模，并提供对系统状态的显式控制，以应用于代理建模和数字孪生等领域。
AI.method: 使用伪随机非线性投影的时间延迟嵌入输入来实现下一代储层计算（NGRC）。特征空间维度可以独立于观测大小进行选择。该方法在吸引子重构和分岔图估计等基准任务上进行了测试，并考虑了部分和有噪声的测量。
AI.result: 在部分和有噪声的测量下，NGRC 在吸引子重构和分岔图估计等基准任务上表现良好。少量测量噪声在训练期间起到了正则化作用，提高了长期自主稳定性。模型在所有测试中都保持稳定，并且能够泛化到训练数据之外。框架提供了对系统状态预测的显式控制。
AI.conclusion: 下一代储层计算（NGRC）提供了一种简单、可扩展且灵活的方法来对动力学系统进行建模，具有良好的稳定性和泛化能力，并能对系统状态进行显式控制，适用于代理建模和数字孪生等应用。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种简单且可扩展的下一代储层计算（NGRC）实现，用于从时间序列数据中对动力学系统进行建模。该方法使用时间延迟嵌入输入的伪随机非线性投影，允许特征空间维度独立于观测大小进行选择，为基于多项式的 NGRC 投影提供了一种灵活的替代方案。我们在基准任务上演示了该方法，包括吸引子重构和分岔图估计，使用了部分和有噪声的测量。我们进一步表明，在训练过程中少量的测量噪声可以作为有效的正则化器，与单独的标准回归相比，提高了长期的自主稳定性。在所有测试中，模型在长时滚动中保持稳定，并且泛化到训练数据之外。该框架提供了对系统状态预测的显式控制，这些特性使得 NGRC 成为代理建模和数字孪生等应用的自然选择。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种下一代储层计算（NGRC）的新方法，该方法通过伪随机非线性投影处理时间延迟嵌入输入，实现了简单、可扩展且灵活的动力学系统建模。该方法在处理不完整和有噪声的数据时表现出良好的性能，并且少量训练噪声反而能提高模型的长期稳定性。所提出的 NGRC 模型不仅在训练数据外具有良好的泛化能力，还能对预测过程中的系统状态进行显式控制，使其成为代理建模和数字孪生等应用的有力工具。
AI.keywords: 储层计算, 动力学系统, 非线性投影, 时间序列, 代理建模
AI.comments: 这项工作提出了一个新颖且实用的 NGRC 框架，它通过允许特征空间维度独立于观测大小进行选择，解决了传统方法的局限性。伪随机投影的使用以及噪声作为正则化器的发现是重要的贡献。然而，该方法在处理极端噪声或高维复杂系统方面的性能仍有待进一步探索。

title: DeepMech: A Machine Learning Framework for Chemical Reaction Mechanism Prediction
summary: Prediction of complete step-by-step chemical reaction mechanisms (CRMs) remains a major challenge. Whereas the traditional approaches in CRM tasks rely on expert-driven experiments or costly quantum chemical computations, contemporary deep learning (DL) alternatives ignore key intermediates and mechanistic steps and often suffer from hallucinations. We present DeepMech, an interpretable graph-based DL framework employing atom- and bond-level attention, guided by generalized templates of mechanistic operations (TMOps), to generate CRMs. Trained on our curated ReactMech dataset (~30K CRMs with 100K atom-mapped and mass-balanced elementary steps), DeepMech achieves 98.98+/-0.12% accuracy in predicting elementary steps and 95.94+/-0.21% in complete CRM tasks, besides maintaining high fidelity even in out-of-distribution scenarios as well as in predicting side and/or byproducts. Extension to multistep CRMs relevant to prebiotic chemistry, demonstrates the ability of DeepMech in effectively reconstructing 2 pathways from simple primordial substrates to complex biomolecules such as serine and aldopentose. Attention analysis identifies reactive atoms/bonds in line with chemical intuition, rendering our model interpretable and suitable for reaction design.

AI.title_translation: 深度机械：用于化学反应机理预测的机器学习框架
AI.tldr: DeepMech是一个基于图的深度学习框架，利用原子和键级别的注意力以及通用机理操作模板（TMOps）来预测化学反应机理（CRMs）。它在ReactMech数据集上进行了训练，并在预测基本步骤和完整CRM方面取得了高精度，同时还能处理分布外场景并识别副产物。该模型还具有可解释性，能够识别反应性原子/键，并已成功应用于模拟生命起源前的化学反应，以重建从简单底物到复杂生物分子的途径。
AI.motivation: 预测完整的化学反应机理（CRMs）是一个重大挑战。传统方法依赖于专家驱动的实验或昂贵的量子化学计算，而现有的深度学习方法则忽略了关键中间体和机理步骤，并且常常出现“幻觉”。
AI.method: DeepMech是一个基于图的深度学习框架，它利用原子和键级别的注意力机制，并以通用的机理操作模板（TMOps）为指导来生成CRMs。该模型在包含约30,000个CRMs和100,000个原子映射和质量平衡的基本步骤的ReactMech数据集上进行了训练。
AI.result: DeepMech在预测基本步骤方面达到了98.98+/-0.12%的准确率，在完整CRM任务方面达到了95.94+/-0.21%的准确率。该模型在分布外场景下仍保持高保真度，并能预测副产物。此外，它还成功地重建了从简单原始底物到复杂生物分子（如丝氨酸和戊糖醛）的两种多步CRM途径。
AI.conclusion: DeepMech是一个可解释的、基于图的深度学习框架，能够准确预测化学反应机理，包括基本步骤和完整的CRM，并且在分布外场景下表现良好。其可解释性使得研究人员能够识别关键的反应位点，并有助于反应设计，例如在生命起源前化学领域。
AI.translation: 化学反应机理（CRMs）的完整分步预测仍然是一个重大挑战。虽然CRM任务中的传统方法依赖于专家驱动的实验或昂贵的量子化学计算，但当前的深度学习（DL）替代方法忽略了关键的中间体和机理步骤，并且常常遭受幻觉的困扰。我们提出了DeepMech，一个可解释的、基于图的深度学习框架，采用原子和键级别的注意力，并以通用的机理操作模板（TMOps）为指导，来生成CRMs。DeepMech在我们的精选ReactMech数据集（约30K CRMs，包含100K个原子映射和质量平衡的基本步骤）上进行了训练，在预测基本步骤方面达到了98.98+/-0.12%的准确率，在完整CRM任务方面达到了95.94+/-0.21%的准确率，此外还能在高保真度地处理分布外场景以及预测副产物。将其扩展到与生命起源前化学相关的多步CRMs，证明了DeepMech能够有效地从简单的原始底物重建到复杂的生物分子（如丝氨酸和戊糖醛）的2条途径。注意力分析识别出与化学直觉一致的反应性原子/键，使我们的模型具有可解释性，并适用于反应设计。
AI.summary: DeepMech是一个新颖的、基于图的深度学习框架，用于准确预测化学反应机理（CRMs）。通过结合原子/键级别的注意力机制和通用的机理操作模板（TMOps），DeepMech克服了现有方法的局限性，能够生成完整的、分步的CRMs，并能处理分布外数据和识别副产物。该模型在ReactMech数据集上表现出卓越的性能，并已成功应用于生命起源前化学等领域，同时其可解释性也为反应设计提供了见解。
AI.keywords: 化学反应机理, 深度学习, 图神经网络, 注意力机制, 反应设计
AI.comments: 该研究提出了一种名为DeepMech的创新性深度学习框架，用于解决化学反应机理预测这一长期存在的挑战。该框架通过引入原子和键级别的注意力机制，并结合通用的机理操作模板（TMOps），显著提高了预测的准确性和可靠性。其在ReactMech数据集上取得的高精度以及在分布外场景下的鲁棒性令人印象深刻。此外，模型的解释性使其能够识别关键的反应位点，这对于理解化学过程和指导新反应的设计具有重要意义。将该模型应用于生命起源前化学领域的研究也展示了其广泛的应用潜力。然而，该研究的局限性可能在于数据集的规模和多样性，以及模型在处理极其复杂或罕见反应时的泛化能力仍有待进一步验证。

title: Forecasting the Future with Yesterday's Climate: Temperature Bias in AI Weather and Climate Models
summary: AI-based climate and weather models have rapidly gained popularity, providing faster forecasts with skill that can match or even surpass that of traditional dynamical models. Despite this success, these models face a key challenge: predicting future climates while being trained only with historical data. In this study, we investigate this issue by analyzing boreal winter land temperature biases in AI weather and climate models. We examine two weather models, FourCastNet V2 Small (FourCastNet) and Pangu Weather (Pangu), evaluating their predictions for 2020-2025 and Ai2 Climate Emulator version 2 (ACE2) for 1996-2010. These time periods lie outside of the respective models' training sets and are significantly more recent than the bulk of their training data, allowing us to assess how well the models generalize to new, i.e. more modern, conditions. We find that all three models produce cold-biased mean temperatures, resembling climates from 15-20 years earlier than the period they are predicting. In some regions, like the Eastern U.S., the predictions resemble climates from as much as 20-30 years earlier. Further analysis shows that FourCastNet's and Pangu's cold bias is strongest in the hottest predicted temperatures, indicating limited training exposure to modern extreme heat events. In contrast, ACE2's bias is more evenly distributed but largest in regions, seasons, and parts of the temperature distribution where climate change has been most pronounced. These findings underscore the challenge of training AI models exclusively on historical data and highlight the need to account for such biases when applying them to future climate prediction.

title: Good quantum codes with addressable and parallelizable transversal non-Clifford gates
summary: In this work, we prove that for any $m>1$, there exists a family of good qudit quantum codes supporting transversal logical $\mathsf{C}^{m-1}\mathsf{Z}$ gates that can address specified logical qudits and be largely executed in parallel. Building on the family of good quantum error-correcting codes presented in He et al. (2025), which support addressable and transversal logical $\mathsf{CCZ}$ gates, we extend their framework and show how to perform large sets of gates in parallel. The construction relies on the classical algebraic geometry codes of Stichtenoth (IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory, 2006). Our results lead to a substantial reduction in the depth overhead of multi-control-$Z$ circuits. In particular, we show that the minimal depth of any logical $\mathsf{C}^{m-1}\mathsf{Z}$ circuit involving qudits from $m$ distinct code blocks is upper bounded by $O(k^{m-1})$, where $k$ is the code dimension. While this overhead is optimal for dense $\mathsf{C}^{m-1}\mathsf{Z}$ circuits, for sparse circuits we discuss how the depth overhead can be significantly reduced by exploiting the structure of the quantum code.

title: Generalized Guarantees for Variational Inference in the Presence of Even and Elliptical Symmetry
summary: We extend several recent results providing symmetry-based guarantees for variational inference (VI) with location-scale families. VI approximates a target density $p$ by the best match $q^*$ in a family $Q$ of tractable distributions that in general does not contain $p$. It is known that VI can recover key properties of $p$, such as its mean and correlation matrix, when $p$ and $Q$ exhibit certain symmetries and $q^*$ is found by minimizing the reverse Kullback-Leibler divergence. We extend these guarantees in two important directions. First, we provide symmetry-based guarantees for $f$-divergences, a broad class that includes the reverse and forward Kullback-Leibler divergences and the $α$-divergences. We highlight properties specific to the reverse Kullback-Leibler divergence under which we obtain our strongest guarantees. Second, we obtain further guarantees for VI when the target density $p$ exhibits even and elliptical symmetries in some but not all of its coordinates. These partial symmetries arise naturally in Bayesian hierarchical models, where the prior induces a challenging geometry but still possesses axes of symmetry. We illustrate these theoretical results in a number of experimental settings.

title: Statistical Properties of Rectified Flow
summary: Rectified flow (Liu et al., 2022; Liu, 2022; Wu et al., 2023) is a method for defining a transport map between two distributions, and enjoys popularity in machine learning, although theoretical results supporting the validity of these methods are scant. The rectified flow can be regarded as an approximation to optimal transport, but in contrast to other transport methods that require optimization over a function space, computing the rectified flow only requires standard statistical tools such as regression or density estimation, which we leverage to develop empirical versions of transport maps. We study some structural properties of the rectified flow, including existence, uniqueness, and regularity, as well as the related statistical properties, such as rates of convergence and central limit theorems, for some selected estimators. To do so, we analyze the bounded and unbounded cases separately as each presents unique challenges. In both cases, we are able to establish convergence at faster rates than those for the usual nonparametric regression and density estimation.

title: Function-on-Function Bayesian Optimization
comments: This manuscript is withdrawn, as the authors intend to further extend and develop the work beyond its current scope
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) has been widely used to optimize expensive and gradient-free objective functions across various domains. However, existing BO methods have not addressed the objective where both inputs and outputs are functions, which increasingly arise in complex systems as advanced sensing technologies. To fill this gap, we propose a novel function-on-function Bayesian optimization (FFBO) framework. Specifically, we first introduce a function-on-function Gaussian process (FFGP) model with a separable operator-valued kernel to capture the correlations between function-valued inputs and outputs. Compared to existing Gaussian process models, FFGP is modeled directly in the function space. Based on FFGP, we define a scalar upper confidence bound (UCB) acquisition function using a weighted operator-based scalarization strategy. Then, a scalable functional gradient ascent algorithm (FGA) is developed to efficiently identify the optimal function-valued input. We further analyze the theoretical properties of the proposed method. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world data demonstrate the superior performance of FFBO over existing approaches.

title: Solving a Research Problem in Mathematical Statistics with AI Assistance
summary:
Over the last few months, AI models including large language models have improved greatly. There are now several documented examples where they have helped professional mathematical scientists prove new results, sometimes even helping resolve known open problems. In this short note, we add another example to the list, by documenting how we were able to solve a previously unsolved research problem in robust mathematical statistics with crucial help from GPT-5. Our problem concerns robust density estimation, where the observations are perturbed by Wasserstein-bounded contaminations. In a previous preprint (Chao and Dobriban, 2023, arxiv:2308.01853v2), we have obtained upper and lower bounds on the minimax optimal estimation error; which were, however, not sharp.
  Starting in October 2025, making significant use of GPT-5 Pro, we were able to derive the minimax optimal error rate (reported in version 3 of the above arxiv preprint). GPT-5 provided crucial help along the way, including by suggesting calculations that we did not think of, and techniques that were not familiar to us, such as the dynamic Benamou-Brenier formulation, for key steps in the analysis. Working with GPT-5 took a few weeks of effort, and we estimate that it could have taken several months to get the same results otherwise. At the same time, there are still areas where working with GPT-5 was challenging: it sometimes provided incorrect references, and glossed over details that sometimes took days of work to fill in. We outline our workflow and steps taken to mitigate issues. Overall, our work can serve as additional documentation for a new age of human-AI collaborative work in mathematical science.

title: Data-Driven Learnability Transition of Measurement-Induced Entanglement
summary: Measurement-induced entanglement (MIE) captures how local measurements generate long-range quantum correlations and drive dynamical phase transitions in many-body systems. Yet estimating MIE experimentally remains challenging: direct evaluation requires extensive post-selection over measurement outcomes, raising the question of whether MIE is accessible with only polynomial resources. We address this challenge by reframing MIE detection as a data-driven learning problem that assumes no prior knowledge of state preparation. Using measurement records alone, we train a neural network in a self-supervised manner to predict the uncertainty metric for MIE--the gap between upper and lower bounds of the average post-measurement bipartite entanglement. Applied to random circuits with one-dimensional all-to-all connectivity and two-dimensional nearest-neighbor coupling, our method reveals a learnability transition with increasing circuit depth: below a threshold, the uncertainty is small and decreases with polynomial measurement data and model parameters, while above it the uncertainty remains large despite increasing resources. We further verify this transition experimentally on current noisy quantum devices, demonstrating its robustness to realistic noise. These results highlight the power of data-driven approaches for learning MIE and delineate the practical limits of its classical learnability.

title: Stronger is not better: Better Augmentations in Contrastive Learning for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Self-supervised contrastive learning is among the recent representation learning methods that have shown performance gains in several downstream tasks including semantic segmentation. This paper evaluates strong data augmentation, one of the most important components for self-supervised contrastive learning's improved performance. Strong data augmentation involves applying the composition of multiple augmentation techniques on images. Surprisingly, we find that the existing data augmentations do not always improve performance for semantic segmentation for medical images. We experiment with other augmentations that provide improved performance.

title: Adversarial Barrier in Uniform Class Separation
comments: 8 pages, 2 figures. A structural obstruction shows uniform separation in HA collapses into fixed-point paradoxes, independent of semantics
summary: We identify a strong structural obstruction to Uniform Separation in constructive arithmetic. The mechanism is independent of semantic content; it emerges whenever two distinct evaluator predicates are sustained in parallel and inference remains uniformly representable in an extension of HA. Under these conditions, any putative Uniform Class Separation principle becomes a distinguished instance of a fixed point construction. The resulting limitation is stricter in scope than classical separation barriers (Baker; Rudich; Aaronson et al.) insofar as it constrains the logical form of uniform separation within HA, rather than limiting particular relativizing, naturalizing, or algebrizing techniques.

title: New Algorithm for Structured OFDM Channel Estimation using Subgroup Duality
summary: This paper presents a group-theoretic framework for structured channel estimation in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM). By modeling subcarriers as the cyclic group \(\mathbb{Z}_N\), we show that nulling a subgroup \(H \subseteq \mathbb{Z}_N\) constrains the channel impulse response to its annihilator \(H^\perp\) in the dual domain. A low-complexity estimator is proposed that detects such structure by evaluating energy concentration across candidate annihilators. Simulations demonstrate consistent gains in mean squared error, bit error rate, and throughput compared with least-squares and linear minimum mean square error baselines, achieving competitive performance with substantially lower complexity and preserved interpretability.

title: LG Uplus System with Multi-Speaker IDs and Discriminator-based Sub-Judges for the WildSpoof Challenge
summary: This paper describes our submission to the WildSpoof Challenge Track 2, which focuses on spoof-aware speaker verification (SASV) in the presence of high-quality text-to-speech (TTS) attacks. We adopt a ResNet-221 back-bone and study two speaker-labeling strategies, namelyDual-Speaker IDs and Multi-Speaker IDs, to explicitly enlarge the margin between bona fide and generated speech in the embedding space. In addition, we propose discriminator-based sub-judge systems that reuse internal features from HiFi-GAN and BigVGAN discriminators, aggregated via multi-query multi-head attentive statistics pooling(MQMHA). Experimental results on the SpoofCeleb corpus show that our system design is effective in improving agnostic detection cost function (a-DCF).

title: A New Particle Filter for Target Tracking in MIMO OFDM Integrated Sensing and Communications
summary: Particle filtering for target tracking using multi-input multi-output (MIMO) pulse-Doppler radars faces three long-standing obstacles: a) the absence of reliable likelihood models for raw radar data; b) the computational and statistical complications that arise when nuisance parameters (e.g., complex path gains) are augmented into state vectors; and c) the prohibitive computational burden of extracting noisy measurements of range, Doppler, and angles from snapshots. Motivated by an optimization-centric interpretation of Bayes' rule, this article addresses these challenges by proposing a new particle filtering framework that evaluates each hypothesized state using a tailored cost function, rather than relying on an explicit likelihood relation. The framework yields substantial reductions in both running time and tracking error compared to existing schemes. In addition, we examine the implementation of the proposed particle filter in MIMO orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing (OFDM) systems, aiming to equip modern communication infrastructure with integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) capabilities. Experiments suggest that MIMO-OFDM with pulse-Doppler processing holds considerable promise for ISAC, particularly when wide bandwidth, extended on-target time, and large antenna aperture are utilized.

title: Secure Wireless Communication Using Distributed Coherent Transmission and Spatial Signal Decomposition
summary: We present a new approach to secure wireless communications using coherent distributed transmission of signals that are spatially decomposed between a two-element distributed antenna array. High-accuracy distributed coordination of microwave wireless systems supports the ability to transmit different parts of a signal from separate transmitters such that they combine coherently at a designated destination. In this paper we explore this concept using a two-element coherent distributed phased array where each of the two transmitters sends a separate component of a communication signal where each symbol is decomposed into a sum of two pseudo-random signal vectors, the coherent summation of which yields the intended symbol. By directing the transmission to an intended receiver using distributed beamforming, the summation of the two vector components is largely confined to a spatial region at the destination receiver. We implement the technique in a 50 wavelength array operating at 3 GHz. We evaluate the symbol error ratio. (SER) in two-dimensional space through simulation and measurement, showing the approach yields a spatially confined secure region where the information is recoverable(i.e., the received signal has low SER), and outside of which the information is unrecoverable (high SER). The proposed system is also compared against a traditional beamforming system where each node sends the same data. We validate experimentally that our approach achieves a low SER of 0.0082 at broadside and a SER above 0.25 at all other locations compared to a traditional beamforming approach that achieves a SER of 0 at all locations measured.

title: Human perception of audio deepfakes: the role of language and speaking style
summary: Audio deepfakes have reached a level of realism that makes it increasingly difficult to distinguish between human and artificial voices, which poses risks such as identity theft or spread of disinformation. Despite these concerns, research on humans' ability to identify deepfakes is limited, with most studies focusing on English and very few exploring the reasons behind listeners' perceptual decisions. This study addresses this gap through a perceptual experiment in which 54 listeners (28 native Spanish speakers and 26 native Japanese speakers) classified voices as natural or synthetic, and justified their choices. The experiment included 80 stimuli (50% artificial), organized according to three variables: language (Spanish/Japanese), speech style (audiobooks/interviews), and familiarity with the voice (familiar/unfamiliar). The goal was to examine how these variables influence detection and to analyze qualitatively the reasoning behind listeners' perceptual decisions. Results indicate an average accuracy of 59.11%, with higher performance on authentic samples. Judgments of vocal naturalness rely on a combination of linguistic and non-linguistic cues. Comparing Japanese and Spanish listeners, our qualitative analysis further reveals both shared cues and notable cross-linguistic differences in how listeners conceptualize the "humanness" of speech. Overall, participants relied primarily on suprasegmental and higher-level or extralinguistic characteristics - such as intonation, rhythm, fluency, pauses, speed, breathing, and laughter - over segmental features. These findings underscore the complexity of human perceptual strategies in distinguishing natural from artificial speech and align partly with prior research emphasizing the importance of prosody and phenomena typical of spontaneous speech, such as disfluencies.

title: SITP: A High-Reliability Semantic Information Transport Protocol Without Retransmission for Semantic Communication
summary: With the evolution of 6G networks, modern communication systems are facing unprecedented demands for high reliability and low latency. However, conventional transport protocols are designed for bit-level reliability, failing to meet the semantic robustness requirements. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a novel Semantic Information Transport Protocol (SITP), which achieves TCP-level reliability and UDP level latency by verifying only packet headers while retaining potentially corrupted payloads for semantic decoding. Building upon SITP, a cross-layer analytical model is established to quantify packet-loss probability across the physical, data-link, network, transport, and application layers. The model provides a unified probabilistic formulation linking signal noise rate (SNR) and packet-loss rate, offering theoretical foundation into end-to-end semantic transmission. Furthermore, a cross-image feature interleaving mechanism is developed to mitigate consecutive burst losses by redistributing semantic features across multiple correlated images, thereby enhancing robustness in burst-fade channels. Extensive experiments show that SITP offers lower latency than TCP with comparable reliability at low SNRs, while matching UDP-level latency and delivering superior reconstruction quality. In addition, the proposed cross-image semantic interleaving mechanism further demonstrates its effectiveness in mitigating degradation caused by bursty packet losses.

title: NOC4SC: A Bandwidth-Efficient Multi-User Semantic Communication Framework for Interference-Resilient Transmission
summary: With the explosive growth of connected devices and emerging applications, current wireless networks are encountering unprecedented demands for massive user access, where the inter-user interference has become a critical challenge to maintaining high quality of service (QoS) in multi-user communication systems. To tackle this issue, we propose a bandwidth-efficient semantic communication paradigm termed Non-Orthogonal Codewords for Semantic Communication (NOC4SC), which enables simultaneous same-frequency transmission without spectrum spreading. By leveraging the Swin Transformer, the proposed NOC4SC framework enables each user to independently extract semantic features through a unified encoder-decoder architecture with shared network parameters across all users, which ensures that the user's data remains protected from unauthorized decoding. Furthermore, we introduce an adaptive NOC and SNR Modulation (NSM) block, which employs deep learning to dynamically regulate SNR and generate approximately orthogonal semantic features within distinct feature subspaces, thereby effectively mitigating inter-user interference. Extensive experiments demonstrate the proposed NOC4SC achieves comparable performance to the DeepJSCC-PNOMA and outperforms other multi-user SemCom baseline methods.

title: QSMnet-INR: Single-Orientation Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping via Implicit Neural Representation in k-Space
comments: 14 pages, 12 figures; submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)
summary: Quantitative Susceptibility Mapping (QSM) quantifies tissue magnetic susceptibility from magnetic-resonance phase data and plays a crucial role in brain microstructure imaging, iron-deposition assessment, and neurological-disease research. However, single-orientation QSM inversion remains highly ill-posed because the dipole kernel exhibits a cone-null region in the Fourier domain, leading to streaking artifacts and structural loss. To overcome this limitation, we propose QSMnet-INR, a deep, physics-informed framework that integrates an Implicit Neural Representation (INR) into the k-space domain. The INR module continuously models multi-directional dipole responses and explicitly completes the cone-null region, while a frequency-domain residual-weighted Dipole Loss enforces physical consistency. The overall network combines a 3D U-Net-based QSMnet backbone with the INR module through alternating optimization for end-to-end joint training. Experiments on the 2016 QSM Reconstruction Challenge, a multi-orientation GRE dataset, and both in-house and public single-orientation clinical data demonstrate that QSMnet-INR consistently outperforms conventional and recent deep-learning approaches across multiple quantitative metrics. The proposed framework shows notable advantages in structural recovery within cone-null regions and in artifact suppression. Ablation studies further confirm the complementary contributions of the INR module and Dipole Loss to detail preservation and physical stability. Overall, QSMnet-INR effectively alleviates the ill-posedness of single-orientation QSM without requiring multi-orientation acquisition, achieving high accuracy, robustness, and strong cross-scenario generalization-highlighting its potential for clinical translation.
comment: 14 pages, 12 figures; submitted to IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI)

title: Joint Channel Estimation and Localization in Pinching-Antenna OFDM Systems: The Blessing of Multipath
summary: Pinching-antenna systems (PASS) have recently attracted considerable attention owing to their capability of flexibly reconfiguring large-scale wireless channels. Motivated by this potential, we investigate the issue of joint localization and channel estimation for the uplink PASS in the presence of multipath dispersion. To this end, a comprehensive multi-user orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) uplink PASS model is first established, where the use of a cyclic prefix (CP) enables the multipath-induced time-domain dispersion to be transformed into a set of superimposed sinusoids in the frequency domain. Building upon this model, we propose a hybrid inference framework capable of accurately estimating both channel parameters and user locations. Specifically, expectation propagation is first employed to mitigate multi-user interference, while the path delays are then extracted from noisy channel state information using an orthogonal matching pursuit (OMP) based approach, or a hybrid belief propagation-variational inference (BP-VI) algorithm. Then the estimated delays are subsequently refined through the embedded geometric information via an iterative localization procedure, wherein the estimated channel matrices are recursively fed back to EP. Furthermore, the Cramer-Rao lower bound (CRLB) is derived to characterize the fundamental estimation limits. Finally, simulation results validate that our proposed framework closely approaches the CRLB, with performance comparable to cooperative multi-base station localization, with significantly fewer RF chains and reduced hardware complexity.

title: Analytical and DNN-Aided Performance Evaluation of IRS-Assisted THz Communication Systems
summary: This paper investigates the performance of an intelligent reflecting surface (IRS)-assisted terahertz (THz) communication system, where the IRS facilitates connectivity between the source and destination nodes in the absence of a direct transmission path. The source-IRS and IRS-destination links are subject to various challenges, including atmospheric attenuation, asymmetric $α$-$μ$ distributed small-scale fading, and beam misalignment-induced pointing errors. The IRS link is characterized using the Laguerre series expansion (LSE) approximation, while both the source-IRS and IRS-destination channels are modeled as independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) $α$-$μ$ fading channels. Furthermore, closed-form analytical expressions are derived for the outage probability (OP), average channel capacity (ACC), and average symbol error rate (ASER) for rectangular QAM (RQAM) and hexagonal QAM (HQAM) schemes over the end-to-end (e2e) link. The impact of random co-phasing and phase quantization errors are also examined. In addition to the theoretical analysis, deep neural network-based frameworks are developed to predict key performance metrics, facilitating fast and accurate system evaluation without computationally intensive analytical computations. Moreover, the asymptotic analysis in the high-signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) regime yields closed-form expressions for coding gain and diversity order, providing further insights into performance trends. Finally, Monte Carlo simulations validate the theoretical formulations and present a comprehensive assessment of system behavior under practical conditions.

title: CKM-Enabled Joint Spatial-Doppler Domain Clutter Suppression for Low-Altitude UAV ISAC
comments: This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication
summary: The rapid development of low-altitude economy has placed higher demands on the sensing of small-sized unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) targets. However, the complex and dynamic low-altitude environment, like the urban and mountainous areas, makes clutter a significant factor affecting the sensing performance. Traditional clutter suppression methods based on Doppler difference or signal strength are inadequate for scenarios with dynamic clutter and slow-moving targets like low-altitude UAVs. In this paper, motivated by the concept of channel knowledge map (CKM), we propose a novel clutter suppression technique for orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) integrated sensing and communication (ISAC) system, by leveraging a new type of CKM named clutter angle map (CLAM). CLAM is a site-specific database, containing location-specific primary clutter angles for the coverage area of the ISAC base station (BS). With CLAM, the sensing signal components corresponding to the clutter environment can be effectively removed before target detection and parameter estimation, which greatly enhances the sensing performance. Besides, to take into account the scenarios when the targets and clutters are in close directions so that pure CLAM-based spatial domain clutter suppression is no longer effective, we further propose a two-step CLAM-enabled joint spatial-Doppler domain clutter suppression algorithm. Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed technique effectively suppresses clutter and enhances target sensing performance, achieving accurate parameter estimation for sensing slow-moving low-altitude UAV targets.
comment: This work has been submitted to IEEE for possible publication

title: Temporal Windows of Integration for Multisensory Wireless Systems as Enablers of Physical AI
summary: Physical artificial intelligence (AI) refers to the AI that interacts with the physical world in real time. Similar to multisensory perception, Physical AI makes decisions based on multimodal updates from sensors and devices. Physical AI thus operates with a finite spatial footprint of its sensory tributaries. The multimodal updates traverse heterogeneous and unreliable paths, involving wireless links. Throughput or latency guarantees do not ensure correct decision-making, as misaligned, misordered, or stale inputs still yield wrong inferences. Preserving decision-time coherence hinges on three timing primitives at the network-application interface: (i) simultaneity, a short coincidence window that groups measurements as co-temporal, (ii) causality, path-wise delivery that never lets a consequence precede its precursor, and (iii) usefulness, a validity horizon that drops information too stale to influence the current action. In this work, we focus on usefulness and adopt temporal window of integration (TWI)-Causality: the TWI enforces decision-time usefulness by assuming path-wise causal consistency and cross-path simultaneity are handled upstream. We model end-to-end path delay as the sum of sensing/propagation, computation, and access/transmission latencies, and formulate network design as minimizing the validity horizon under a delivery reliability constraint. In effect, this calibrates delay-reliability budgets for a timing-aware system operating over sensors within a finite spatial footprint. The joint choice of horizon and per-path reliability is cast as a convex optimization problem, solved to global optimality to obtain the minimal horizon and per-path allocation of reliability. This is compared favourably to a benchmark based on uniform-after-threshold allocation. Overall, this study contributes to timing-aware Physical AI in next-generation networks.

title: Robust Speech Activity Detection in the Presence of Singing Voice
comments: This paper has been published in: 2025 IEEE Workshop on Applications of Signal Processing to Audio and Acoustics (WASPAA)
summary: Speech Activity Detection (SAD) systems often misclassify singing as speech, leading to degraded performance in applications such as dialogue enhancement and automatic speech recognition. We introduce Singing-Robust Speech Activity Detection ( SR-SAD ), a neural network designed to robustly detect speech in the presence of singing. Our key contributions are: i) a training strategy using controlled ratios of speech and singing samples to improve discrimination, ii) a computationally efficient model that maintains robust performance while reducing inference runtime, and iii) a new evaluation metric tailored to assess SAD robustness in mixed speech-singing scenarios. Experiments on a challenging dataset spanning multiple musical genres show that SR-SAD maintains high speech detection accuracy (AUC = 0.919) while rejecting singing. By explicitly learning to distinguish between speech and singing, SR-SAD enables more reliable SAD in mixed speech-singing scenarios.

title: On the Ambiguity Function of OFDM-based ISAC Signals Under Non-Ideal Power Amplifiers
comments: This article has been submitted to the IEEE Transactions on Vehicular Technology
summary: Integrated Sensing and Communications (ISAC) has garnered significant attention as a promising technology for next-generation wireless and vehicular communications. Among candidate waveforms, Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) has been extensively investigated over the past decade for its robustness against frequency-selective fading and its favorable ranging performance. However, the waveform's sensing and communication (S&C) performance depends strongly on the modulation scheme; while variable-amplitude constellations such as quadrature amplitude (QAM) are more efficient for communication, constant-modulus modulations such as phase shift keying (PSK) are more suitable for sensing. Yet, it remains unclear whether these findings persist under power amplifier (PA) nonlinearity. Because OFDM signals exhibit a high peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR), they require highly linear PAs to avoid distortion, which conflicts with radar requirements, where high transmit power is always beneficial for sensing. In this work, we analyze the effect of PA-induced distortions on the sensing task for PSK and QAM constellations. By introducing the Signal-to-Distortion Ratio (SDR), we examine the extent of the distortion limitation on the ranging task. We complement simulation results with a theoretical characterization of the ambiguity function (AF), thereby explicitly demonstrating how distortion artifacts manifest in the zero-Doppler sidelobes (i.e, ranging sidelobes) and the zero-delay sidelobes. Simulations show that PA distortions impose a palpable performance ceiling for both constellations, reshape the AF, and reduce detection probability, diminishing the theoretical advantage of unimodular signaling and further compromising the OFDM sensing performance with non-uniform envelope signals.

AI.title_translation: 非理想功率放大器下基于OFDM的ISAC信号模糊函数研究
AI.tldr: 本文研究了非理想功率放大器对基于OFDM的ISAC信号（特别是PSK和QAM调制）的感知性能（包括模糊函数和测距性能）的影响，发现PA失真会显著限制性能并改变模糊函数。
AI.motivation: 集成感知与通信 (ISAC) 是一种有前景的下一代无线和车载通信技术。OFDM在过去十年中因其对频率选择性衰落的鲁棒性和良好的测距性能而得到广泛研究。然而，OFDM波形的感知和通信(S&C)性能强烈依赖于调制方案。虽然QAM等变幅度星座对通信更有效，但PSK等恒模调制更适合感知。目前尚不清楚这些发现是否在功率放大器 (PA) 非线性条件下仍然成立。由于OFDM信号具有高峰均功率比 (PAPR)，它们需要高度线性的PA以避免失真，这与雷达要求（高发射功率始终有利于感知）相冲突。
AI.method: 本文分析了PA引起的失真对PSK和QAM星座感知任务的影响。通过引入信噪比失真比 (SDR)，研究了失真限制对测距任务的影响程度。通过模糊函数 (AF) 的理论表征补充了仿真结果，明确展示了失真伪影如何体现在零多普勒旁瓣（即测距旁瓣）和零延迟旁瓣中。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明，PA失真对两种星座都施加了明显的性能上限，重塑了AF，并降低了检测概率。这削弱了单模信号的理论优势，并进一步损害了非均匀包络OFDM信号的感知性能。
AI.conclusion: 非理想功率放大器引起的失真对基于OFDM的ISAC信号的感知性能有显著负面影响，会限制测距性能、改变模糊函数并降低检测概率，尤其对非均匀包络信号影响更大，削弱了单模信号的理论优势。
AI.translation: 集成感知与通信 (ISAC) 作为下一代无线和车载通信的有前景技术，受到了广泛关注。在候选波形中，正交频分复用 (OFDM) 因其对频率选择性衰落的鲁棒性和良好的测距性能，在过去十年中得到了广泛研究。然而，该波形的感知和通信 (S&C) 性能强烈依赖于调制方案；虽然正交幅度调制 (QAM) 等变幅度星座对通信更有效，但相移键控 (PSK) 等恒模调制更适合感知。然而，目前尚不清楚这些发现是否在功率放大器 (PA) 非线性条件下仍然存在。由于OFDM信号具有高峰均功率比 (PAPR)，它们需要高度线性的PA以避免失真，这与雷达要求（高发射功率始终有利于感知）相冲突。在这项工作中，我们分析了PA引起的失真对PSK和QAM星座感知任务的影响。通过引入信噪比失真比 (SDR)，我们检查了失真限制对测距任务的程度。我们通过模糊函数 (AF) 的理论表征补充了仿真结果，从而明确展示了失真伪影如何体现在零多普勒旁瓣（即测距旁瓣）和零延迟旁瓣中。仿真结果表明，PA失真对两种星座都施加了明显的性能上限，重塑了AF，并降低了检测概率，削弱了单模信号的理论优势，并进一步损害了非均匀包络信号的OFDM感知性能。
AI.summary: 本文研究了非理想功率放大器对基于OFDM的集成感知与通信 (ISAC) 信号感知性能的影响。重点分析了PSK和QAM调制下PA引起的失真如何影响测距任务和模糊函数。研究发现，PA失真会显著限制OFDM信号的感知性能，改变模糊函数形状，并降低检测概率，尤其对非均匀包络信号的影响更为明显，甚至削弱了恒模信号的理论优势。
AI.keywords: ISAC, OFDM, 功率放大器, 模糊函数, 失真
AI.comments: 该论文深入探讨了OFDM-ISAC系统在实际部署中面临的一个关键挑战——功率放大器非线性。通过结合理论分析和仿真，明确揭示了PA失真对感知性能，特别是模糊函数和测距精度的负面影响。其创新之处在于引入SDR来量化失真，并详细分析了失真伪影在模糊函数旁瓣中的表现。这对于理解和设计更鲁棒的ISAC系统具有重要指导意义，尤其是在考虑实际硬件限制时。

title: Energy-Efficient Federated Learning with Relay-Assisted Aggregation in IIoT Networks
summary: This paper presents an energy-efficient transmission framework for federated learning (FL) in industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) environments with strict latency and energy constraints. Machinery subnetworks (SNs) collaboratively train a global model by uploading local updates to an edge server (ES), either directly or via neighboring SNs acting as decode-and-forward relays. To enhance communication efficiency, relays perform partial aggregation before forwarding the models to the ES, significantly reducing overhead and training latency. We analyze the convergence behavior of this relay-assisted FL scheme. To address the inherent energy efficiency (EE) challenges, we decompose the original non-convex optimization problem into sub-problems addressing computation and communication energy separately. An SN grouping algorithm categorizes devices into single-hop and two-hop transmitters based on latency minimization, followed by a relay selection mechanism. To improve FL reliability, we further maximize the number of SNs that meet the roundwise delay constraint, promoting broader participation and improved convergence stability under practical IIoT data distributions. Transmit power levels are then optimized to maximize EE, and a sequential parametric convex approximation (SPCA) method is proposed for joint configuration of system parameters. We further extend the EE formulation to the imperfect channel state information (ICSI). Simulation results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly enhances convergence speed, reduces outage probability from 10-2 in single-hop to 10-6 and achieves substantial energy savings, with the SPCA approach reducing energy consumption by at least 2x compared to unaggregated cooperation and up to 6x over single-hop transmission.

AI.title_translation: 继电器辅助聚合的IIoT网络中高能效联邦学习
AI.tldr: 为解决IIoT中FL的能效和延迟问题，本文提出了一种继电器辅助聚合传输框架，通过中继部分聚合、SN分组、继电器选择和SPCA联合优化系统参数，显著提高了收敛速度、可靠性，并将能耗降低了高达6倍。
AI.motivation: 解决工业物联网（IIoT）环境中联邦学习（FL）所面临的严格延迟和能耗限制，并提高通信效率。
AI.method:
1. 提出继电器辅助传输框架：子网络（SNs）通过邻近SN（作为解码转发继电器）或直接上传模型更新。继电器在转发前执行部分聚合，以减少开销和训练延迟。
2. 分析继电器辅助FL方案的收敛行为。
3. 将原始的非凸能效（EE）优化问题分解为计算和通信能耗的子问题。
4. 采用基于延迟最小化的SN分组算法，将设备分类为单跳和双跳发射器，并进行继电器选择。
5. 最大化满足每轮延迟约束的SN数量，以提高可靠性和收敛稳定性。
6. 优化发射功率以最大化EE，并提出序列参数凸近似（SPCA）方法进行系统参数的联合配置。
7. 将EE公式扩展到不完美信道状态信息（ICSI）的情况。
AI.result:
1. 显著提高了收敛速度。
2. 将中断概率从单跳传输的10⁻²降低到10⁻⁶。
3. 实现了可观的能源节约：SPCA方法相比未聚合的协作至少减少2倍能耗，相比单跳传输最多减少6倍能耗。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种用于工业物联网（IIoT）环境中联邦学习（FL）的高能效传输框架，以应对严格的延迟和能耗限制。机械子网络（SNs）通过直接或经由充当解码转发继电器的邻近SN，协作地将本地更新上传到边缘服务器（ES）。为了提高通信效率，继电器在将模型转发给ES之前执行部分聚合，显著减少了开销和训练延迟。我们分析了这种继电器辅助FL方案的收敛行为。为了解决固有的能效（EE）挑战，我们将原始的非凸优化问题分解为分别处理计算和通信能耗的子问题。首先，基于延迟最小化，采用SN分组算法将设备分类为单跳和双跳发射器，然后进行继电器选择机制。为了提高FL的可靠性，我们进一步最大化满足每轮延迟约束的SN数量，从而在实际IIoT数据分布下促进更广泛的参与和改进的收敛稳定性。然后优化发射功率水平以最大化EE，并提出序列参数凸近似（SPCA）方法用于系统参数的联合配置。我们进一步将EE公式扩展到不完美信道状态信息（ICSI）的情况。仿真结果表明，所提出的框架显著提高了收敛速度，将中断概率从单跳的10⁻²降低到10⁻⁶，并实现了可观的能源节约，其中SPCA方法相比未聚合协作减少至少2倍能耗，相比单跳传输最多减少6倍能耗。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种用于受限IIoT网络的能效联邦学习（FL）框架，利用继电器辅助聚合机制，允许子网络（SNs）通过中继进行部分聚合上传模型更新。为最大化能效，作者将非凸优化问题分解，并设计了基于延迟最小化的SN分组和继电器选择算法。通过最大化参与SN数量和使用序列参数凸近似（SPCA）进行联合参数配置，该方案显著提高了收敛速度和可靠性，并实现了高达6倍的能耗降低。
AI.keywords: 联邦学习（FL）, 工业物联网（IIoT）, 继电器辅助聚合, 能效（EE）, 序列参数凸近似（SPCA）
AI.comments: 创新性在于将中继传输（继电器辅助聚合）引入到IIoT的联邦学习中，通过在边缘进行部分聚合来解决严格的延迟和能效限制。其重要性体现在为资源受限的工业环境提供了一种可靠且高效的分布式学习解决方案。方法论上的亮点是复杂非凸问题的分解处理以及使用序列参数凸近似（SPCA）进行联合优化，并考虑了不完美信道状态信息（ICSI），使模型更贴近实际部署。

title: A Speculative GLRT-Backed Approach for Adversarial Resilience on Deep Learning-Based Array Processing
summary: Classical array processing methods such as the generalized likelihood ratio test (GLRT) provide statistically grounded solutions for signal detection and direction-of-arrival (DoA) estimation, but their high computational cost limits their use in low-latency settings. Deep learning (DL) has recently emerged as an efficient alternative, offering fast inference for array processing tasks. However, DL models lack statistical guarantees and, moreover, are highly susceptible to adversarial perturbations, raising fundamental concerns about their reliability in adversarial wireless environments. To address these challenges, we propose an adversarially resilient speculative array processing framework that consists of a low-latency DL classifier backed by a theoretically-grounded GLRT validator, where DL is used for fast speculative inference and later confirmed with the GLRT. We show that second order statistics of the received array, which the GLRT operates on, are spatially invariant to L-p bounded adversarial perturbations, providing adversarial robustness and theoretically-grounded validation of DL predictions. Empirical evaluations under multiple L-p bounds, perturbation designs, and perturbation magnitudes corroborate our theoretical findings, demonstrating the superior performance of our proposed framework in comparison to multiple state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.title_translation: 一种用于深度学习阵列处理的推测性GLRT支持的抗对抗性方法
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合快速深度学习（DL）和可靠的广义似然比检验（GLRT）验证器的阵列处理框架，以实现低延迟和抗对抗性。
AI.motivation: 经典的阵列处理方法（如GLRT）计算成本高，不适用于低延迟环境。深度学习（DL）虽然推理速度快，但缺乏统计保证，且极易受到对抗性扰动的影响。
AI.method: 提出了一种抗对抗性的推测性阵列处理框架。该框架使用低延迟的DL分类器进行快速推测性推理，并由具有理论基础的GLRT验证器进行确认。其核心在于，GLRT所操作的接收阵列的二阶统计量对$L_p$有界对抗性扰动具有空间不变性，从而提供了鲁棒性。
AI.result: 理论上证明了GLRT操作的二阶统计量对$L_p$有界对抗性扰动具有空间不变性，提供了对抗性鲁棒性。实证评估表明，该框架在多种扰动设置下，性能优于现有的多个先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种推测性GLRT支持的框架，成功地将低延迟的DL推理与具有理论基础的GLRT验证相结合，解决了深度学习在对抗性无线环境中的可靠性问题，并展示了优越的性能。
AI.translation: 广义似然比检验（GLRT）等经典阵列处理方法为信号检测和到达角（DoA）估计提供了基于统计学的解决方案，但其高计算成本限制了它们在低延迟环境中的应用。深度学习（DL）最近作为一种高效的替代方案出现，为阵列处理任务提供了快速推理能力。然而，DL模型缺乏统计保证，并且极易受到对抗性扰动的影响，这引发了对其在对抗性无线环境中可靠性的根本担忧。为了解决这些挑战，我们提出了一种抗对抗性的推测性阵列处理框架，该框架由一个低延迟的DL分类器和一个具有理论基础的GLRT验证器组成，其中DL用于快速推测性推理，随后由GLRT进行确认。我们证明了GLRT所操作的接收阵列的二阶统计量对$L_p$有界对抗性扰动具有空间不变性，从而提供了对抗性鲁棒性和对DL预测的理论基础验证。在多种$L_p$边界、扰动设计和扰动幅度下的实证评估证实了我们的理论发现，表明我们提出的框架与多个最先进的基线相比具有卓越的性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种抗对抗性的推测性阵列处理框架，旨在解决深度学习（DL）在阵列处理中缺乏统计保证和易受对抗性攻击的问题，同时保持低延迟。该框架利用DL进行快速推测性推理，并由具有理论基础的广义似然比检验（GLRT）验证器进行确认。研究证明了GLRT操作的二阶统计量对$L_p$有界对抗性扰动具有空间不变性，从而确保了鲁棒性。实验结果证实了该框架的性能优于现有基线方法。
AI.keywords: 深度学习, 阵列处理, 对抗性鲁棒性, GLRT, 推测性推理
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于成功地将深度学习的快速推理能力与经典方法（GLRT）的统计严谨性和对抗性鲁棒性相结合。通过理论证明接收阵列的二阶统计量对$L_p$有界对抗性扰动具有空间不变性，为DL预测提供了一种新颖且有理论基础的验证机制，极大地提高了DL在对抗性无线环境中的可靠性。

title: 389.3-Tb/s 1017-km C-band Transmission over Field-Installed 12-Coupled-Core Fiber Cable with >12-Tb/s Spatial MIMO Channels
comments: Published in 50th European Conference on Optical Communication (ECOC2024), Postdeadline paper Th3B.1
summary: We demonstrate 4.65-THz WDM/SDM transmission of 140-Gbaud PS-QAM signals over field-installed 12-coupled-core fiber cable with standard cladding diameter, achieving a record 0.455 Pb/s coupled-core capacity in a field environment. We also demonstrate 0.389 Pb/s over-1000-km transmission of spatial MIMO channels with >12 Tb/s/wavelength net bitrate.

AI.title_translation: 389.3 Tb/s 1017公里C波段传输，采用现场安装的12耦合纤芯光缆，具有>12 Tb/s空间MIMO信道。

title: Machine Learning-Driven Adaptive Power Allocation for Optical Wireless Networks
summary: Vertical Cavity Surface Emitting Lasers (VCSELs) have gained popularity in Optical Wireless Communication (OWC) due to their high modulation bandwidth, narrow spectral width, and directional beam, offering improved spectral efficiency and reduced multipath dispersion compared to Light Emitting Diodes (LEDs). In this work, we explore the deployment of VCSELs as Access Points (APs) in an indoor environment under mobility and time varying user distributions. To enhance performance, a Merged Access Point (MAP) topology is introduced to extend the serving area of each cell, whilst Zero Forcing (ZF) precoding is employed for inter user interference management. A sum rate maximisation problem is then formulated to maintain high quality network operation in the dynamic environment. Although deterministic methods can solve the formulated problem, they become impractical in real time due to computational complexity, particularly under high user mobility and rapidly changing channel conditions. To address this, we propose a hybrid Machine Learning (ML) based solution combining a low complexity distance based user association algorithm with a Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) for adaptive power allocation. Simulation results show that the proposed hybrid association CNN framework achieves near optimal performance while substantially reducing computation complexity relative to optimisation based schemes. Furthermore, it operates in real time, with measured median and P95 inference latencies in the millisecond range, and maintains a small empirical worst-case gap to the Mixed Integer Linear Programming (MILP) optimum, demonstrating both practicality and robustness under mobility.

AI.title_translation: 机器学习驱动的可见光无线网络自适应功率分配
AI.tldr: 在VCSEL光无线网络中，针对高用户移动性和动态环境，本文提出了一种混合机器学习方案（基于距离的用户关联+CNN功率分配），实现了接近最优的性能，同时大幅降低了计算复杂性，确保了实时操作（毫秒级延迟）。
AI.motivation: 在室内VCSEL光无线通信（OWC）环境中，用户移动性和分布是时变的。为了在动态环境中维持高质量的网络运行，需要解决一个和速率最大化问题。然而，传统的确定性方法计算复杂度高，难以在实时场景中应用，尤其是在高用户移动性和快速变化的信道条件下。
AI.method: 采用了VCSEL作为接入点（AP），并引入了合并接入点（MAP）拓扑以扩展覆盖范围，使用零迫（ZF）预编码来管理用户间干扰。和速率最大化问题被公式化。为解决该问题，提出了一种混合机器学习（ML）方案，结合了低复杂度的基于距离的用户关联算法和用于自适应功率分配的卷积神经网络（CNN）。
AI.result: 提出的混合关联-CNN框架实现了接近最优的性能，同时相对于基于优化的方案大幅降低了计算复杂度。它能实时运行，测量的中位数和P95推断延迟在毫秒范围内，并且保持了与混合整数线性规划（MILP）最优解之间较小的经验最坏情况差距，证明了在移动性下的实用性和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 提出的混合机器学习方案（基于距离的用户关联结合CNN功率分配）在VCSEL光无线网络中实现了接近最优的性能，同时解决了传统优化方法计算复杂度高的问题，为动态环境下的自适应功率分配提供了一个实用且鲁棒的实时解决方案。
AI.translation: 垂直腔面发射激光器（VCSELs）因其高调制带宽、窄光谱宽度和定向光束，在可见光无线通信（OWC）中越来越受欢迎，与发光二极管（LEDs）相比，它们提供了更高的频谱效率和更少的多径色散。在这项工作中，我们探索了在具有移动性和时变用户分布的室内环境中部署VCSEL作为接入点（APs）。为了增强性能，引入了合并接入点（MAP）拓扑来扩展每个小区的服务区域，同时采用零迫（ZF）预编码进行用户间干扰管理。随后，公式化了一个和速率最大化问题，以在动态环境中维持高质量的网络运行。尽管确定性方法可以解决所提出的问题，但由于计算复杂度高，特别是在高用户移动性和快速变化的信道条件下，它们在实时应用中变得不切实际。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种混合机器学习（ML）解决方案，它将低复杂度的基于距离的用户关联算法与用于自适应功率分配的卷积神经网络（CNN）相结合。仿真结果表明，所提出的混合关联-CNN框架在大幅降低相对于基于优化的方案的计算复杂度的同时，实现了接近最优的性能。此外，它能实时操作，测量的中位数和P95推断延迟在毫秒范围内，并保持了与混合整数线性规划（MILP）最优解之间较小的经验最坏情况差距，证明了在移动性下的实用性和鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文研究了室内VCSEL光无线网络在移动性和动态用户分布下的性能增强问题。通过引入MAP拓扑和ZF预编码，并将网络操作目标公式化为和速率最大化。鉴于传统优化方法计算复杂度高，无法实时应用，作者提出了一种混合机器学习方案，该方案结合了基于距离的用户关联算法和用于自适应功率分配的CNN。仿真结果证明，该混合框架在大幅降低复杂度的同时实现了接近最优的性能，并具备毫秒级的实时操作能力和高鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: 机器学习, 自适应功率分配, 光无线通信 (OWC), VCSEL, 卷积神经网络 (CNN)
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于提出了一种混合机器学习框架，用以解决动态VCSEL光无线网络中自适应功率分配的实时性问题。通过将复杂的和速率最大化优化问题分解为低复杂度的用户关联（基于距离）和高效的功率分配（基于CNN），成功地将计算复杂度从不切实际的水平降低到毫秒级的实时操作水平。这一方法对于推动OWC网络在实际室内高移动性环境中的部署至关重要，因为它解决了传统优化方法在速度上的根本限制。虽然性能是“接近最优”，但其在复杂性和实用性之间的权衡是高度成功的。

title: Low Complexity Weight Flexible Decoding Schemes of Linear Block Code for 6G xURLLC
summary: Low complexity error correction code is a key enabler for next generation ultra-reliable low-latency communications (xURLLC) in six generation (6G). Against this background, this paper proposes a decoding scheme for linear block code by leveraging certain interesting properties of dual codewords. It is found that dual codewords with flexible weights can provide useful decoding information for the locations and magnitudes of error bits, which yielding higher reliability performance. In addition, two decoding schemes are proposed, in which one directly utilizes intrinsic information for iterative decoding, and the other combines prior channel information with intrinsic information for decoding. Both schemes are implemented using vector multiplication and real-number comparisons, making them easy to implement in hardware. Simulation results demonstrate the validness of our study.

title: A Low-Complexity Speech Codec Using Parametric Dithering for ASR
comments: 10 pages, 8 figures, Accepted 2026 Data Compression Conference
summary: Dithering is a technique commonly used to improve the perceptual quality of lossy data compression. In this work, we analytically and experimentally justify the use of dithering for ASR input compression. We formalize an understanding of optimal ASR performance under lossy input compression and leverage this to propose a parametric dithering technique for a low-complexity speech compression pipeline. The method performs well at 1-bit resolution, showing a 25\% relative CER improvement, while also demonstrating improvements of 32.4\% and 33.5\% at 2- and 3-bit resolution, respectively, with our second dither choice yielding a reduced data rate. The proposed codec is adaptable to meet performance targets or stay within entropy constraints.

AI.title_translation: 用于ASR的低复杂度参数化抖动语音编解码器
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种用于ASR输入压缩的低复杂度参数化抖动语音编解码器。该方法在1位、2位和3位分辨率下均实现了显著的相对字符错误率（CER）改进（分别为25%、32.4%和33.5%），并且具有数据速率降低的潜力。
AI.motivation: 抖动技术常用于提高有损数据压缩的感知质量。本文旨在通过分析和实验证明抖动技术对于ASR输入压缩的有效性，并在此基础上追求在有损输入压缩下实现最佳的ASR性能。
AI.method: 首先，对有损输入压缩下的最佳ASR性能进行了理解上的形式化。在此基础上，提出了一种参数化抖动技术，并将其应用于低复杂度的语音压缩流程中。实验中探索了不同的抖动选择（包括一种能降低数据速率的选择）。
AI.result: 在1位分辨率下，该方法显示出25%的相对字符错误率（CER）改进；在2位和3位分辨率下，分别显示出32.4%和33.5%的改进。第二种抖动选择能够实现降低数据速率的效果。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的编解码器具有适应性，能够满足性能目标或保持在熵约束范围内。
AI.translation: 抖动是一种常用于改善有损数据压缩感知质量的技术。在这项工作中，我们从分析和实验上证明了抖动用于ASR输入压缩的合理性。我们正式理解了有损输入压缩下的最佳ASR性能，并利用这一点提出了一种用于低复杂度语音压缩流程的参数化抖动技术。该方法在1位分辨率下表现良好，显示出25%的相对CER改进，同时在2位和3位分辨率下分别展示了32.4%和33.5%的改进，其中我们的第二种抖动选择能够降低数据速率。所提出的编解码器具有适应性，可以满足性能目标或保持在熵约束范围内。
AI.summary: 本文研究了抖动技术在自动语音识别（ASR）输入压缩中的应用。通过形式化对有损压缩下最优ASR性能的理解，作者提出了一种低复杂度的参数化抖动语音编解码器。实验结果表明，该方法在极低比特率下（1位至3位）能显著提升ASR性能，相对字符错误率（CER）改进高达25%至33.5%，同时还提供了一种能降低数据速率的抖动选择。该编解码器设计灵活，可适应不同的性能或熵约束要求。
AI.keywords: 语音编解码器, 参数化抖动, ASR, 低复杂度, 有损压缩
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新点在于将传统上用于提高感知质量的抖动技术，应用于优化ASR系统的输入压缩性能。在极低比特率（如1位）下实现显著的相对CER改进（25%），表明该参数化抖动方法在维持语音识别准确性方面具有高效性。对于资源受限或需要低延迟传输的应用场景，这种低复杂度的编解码器具有重要的实用价值。其核心价值在于提供了一种在保证识别性能的同时大幅降低数据速率的解决方案。

title: Refuting "Debunking the GAMLSS Myth: Simplicity Reigns in Pulmonary Function Diagnostics"
comments: Letter to the editor of Respiratory Medicine
summary: We read with interest the above article by Zavorsky (2025, Respiratory Medicine, doi:10.1016/j.rmed.2024.107836) concerning reference equations for pulmonary function testing. The author compares a Generalized Additive Model for Location, Scale, and Shape (GAMLSS), which is the standard adopted by the Global Lung Function Initiative (GLI), with a segmented linear regression (SLR) model, for pulmonary function variables. The author presents an interesting comparison; however there are some fundamental issues with the approach. We welcome this opportunity for discussion of the issues that it raises. The author's contention is that (1) SLR provides "prediction accuracies on par with GAMLSS"; and (2) the GAMLSS model equations are "complicated and require supplementary spline tables", whereas the SLR is "more straightforward, parsimonious, and accessible to a broader audience". We respectfully disagree with both of these points.

AI.title_translation: 驳斥“揭穿GAMLSS神话：简单性在肺功能诊断中占据主导地位”
AI.tldr: 本文对一篇声称分段线性回归（SLR）与广义加性模型（GAMLSS，GLI标准）在肺功能诊断准确性上相当，且SLR更简单的文章提出了质疑，并明确反对其提出的两点主要论断。
AI.motivation: 针对Zavorsky（2025）关于肺功能参考方程的文章，指出其方法存在一些根本性问题，并对该文提出的关于GAMLSS模型和分段线性回归（SLR）模型的两个主要论点（即SLR的预测准确性与GAMLSS相当，且SLR更简单易用）表示不同意，借此机会进行讨论。
AI.method: 本文是对一篇既有研究（Zavorsky, 2025）的评论和辩论，旨在指出原研究方法中的根本性问题并反驳其论点。具体用于反驳的技术或数据分析方法在摘要中未提及。
AI.translation: 我们饶有兴趣地阅读了Zavorsky（2025，Respiratory Medicine, doi:10.1016/j.rmed.2024.107836）关于肺功能测试参考方程的上述文章。作者比较了广义加性位置、尺度和形状模型（GAMLSS，这是全球肺功能倡议GLI所采用的标准）与分段线性回归（SLR）模型在肺功能变量中的应用。作者提出了一个有趣的比较；然而，其方法存在一些根本性问题。我们欢迎借此机会讨论其引发的问题。作者的论点是：（1）SLR提供的“预测准确性与GAMLSS相当”；（2）GAMLSS模型方程“复杂且需要补充的样条表”，而SLR则“更直接、更简约，更容易被更广泛的受众所接受”。我们对这两点均表示异议。
AI.summary: 本文是对一篇比较肺功能参考方程（GAMLSS与SLR）的论文的回应。原论文声称，更简单的分段线性回归（SLR）模型在预测准确性上与作为GLI标准的广义加性模型（GAMLSS）相当，并且GAMLSS过于复杂。本文作者指出原论文的方法存在根本性问题，并明确地对SLR准确性与GAMLSS相当以及GAMLSS复杂性高的这两个主要论点表示不同意。
AI.keywords: 肺功能测试, GAMLSS, 分段线性回归, 参考方程, GLI
AI.comments: 本文的重要性在于维护了广义加性模型（GAMLSS）作为全球肺功能倡议（GLI）标准的地位，并对简化模型（SLR）的适用性提出了质疑。这反映了生物统计学界在模型选择上的经典争议：即在医学诊断中，是应选择具有更高统计复杂性和拟合优度的标准模型（GAMLSS），还是选择牺牲部分精度以换取更高透明度和可访问性的简约模型（SLR）。本文的局限性在于，它只是一个评论性文章，其摘要并未提供具体的证据或数据来支持其反驳，而是停留在观点的表达上。

title: Access to healthcare for people with Alzheimer's Diseases and related dementias
summary: Background: Alzheimer's Disease and Related Dementias (ADRD) affects millions worldwide. Significant disparities exist in ADRD diagnosis and care, disproportionately impacting minority and socioeconomically vulnerable populations Objective: In this study, we investigate the relationship between ADRD density and accessibility to healthcare. We identify underserved and overserved areas in Maryland based on diagnosed cases and mortality due to ADRD, focusing on geographic disparities in care. Methods: 2023 Maryland ADRD patients were identified using ICD-10 codes from. Accessibility was measured using the Kernel Density Two-Step Floating Catchment Area (KD2SFCA) method. The Gini index and t-tests were used to analyze disparities between urban and rural areas. Hot Spot Analysis Getis-Ord Gi* and local bivariate relationships analysis were applied to assess spatial correlations. Principal component analysis (PCA) was applied to calculate the health risk index. Results: Hospital accessibility was unevenly distributed. Mortality rates from ADRD were higher in underserved areas with fewer hospitals. Hot spot analysis shows eastern and southern Maryland have zones with high mortality per population and per ADRD patient, surrounded by similarly high-rate zones. Central Maryland shows lower death rates per patient but more hospital facilities. In eastern Maryland, higher poverty areas are surrounded by zones with lower accessibility and higher health risk indices. Conclusion: Hospital accessibility is unevenly distributed, creating major rural disparities. Underserved regions in terms of access to healthcare facilities, particularly in eastern and southern Maryland, exhibit high ADRD mortality rates despite low diagnosis rates. This suggests that many ADRD cases remain undiagnosed, underdiagnosed, or subject to delayed treatment.

AI.title_translation: 阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症患者的医疗保健可及性
AI.tldr: 本研究使用地理空间方法分析了马里兰州ADRD患者的医疗可及性。结果显示，医院可及性分布不均，导致农村地区和东南部地区服务不足，这些地区死亡率高但诊断率低，暗示存在大量的漏诊或治疗延迟。
AI.motivation: 阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（ADRD）影响全球数百万人，但在诊断和护理方面存在显著差异，尤其不成比例地影响少数族裔和弱势社会经济群体。研究旨在调查ADRD密度与医疗保健可及性之间的关系。
AI.method: 使用ICD-10代码识别2023年马里兰州的ADRD患者。采用核密度两步浮动集水区（KD2SFCA）方法测量可及性。使用基尼指数和t检验分析城乡差异。应用Getis-Ord Gi*热点分析和局部双变量关系分析评估空间相关性。应用主成分分析（PCA）计算健康风险指数。
AI.result: 医院可及性分布不均，造成严重的城乡差异。在医院较少的服务不足地区，ADRD死亡率更高。热点分析显示，马里兰州东部和南部地区的每人口和每ADRD患者死亡率高。马里兰州中部患者死亡率较低但医疗设施更多。东部地区高贫困区被低可及性和高健康风险指数区包围。
AI.conclusion: 医院可及性分布不均导致了严重的农村差异。在医疗设施可及性方面服务不足的地区（尤其是马里兰州东部和南部），尽管诊断率低，但ADRD死亡率很高。这表明许多ADRD病例仍未被诊断、诊断不足或治疗延迟。
AI.translation: 背景：阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（ADRD）影响全球数百万人口。ADRD的诊断和护理存在显著差异，不成比例地影响少数族裔和弱势社会经济群体。目的：在本研究中，我们调查了ADRD密度与医疗保健可及性之间的关系。我们根据ADRD的诊断病例和死亡率，确定了马里兰州服务不足和过度服务的地区，重点关注护理方面的地理差异。方法：使用ICD-10代码识别了2023年马里兰州的ADRD患者。可及性采用核密度两步浮动集水区（KD2SFCA）方法测量。使用基尼指数和t检验分析城乡地区之间的差异。应用Getis-Ord Gi*热点分析和局部双变量关系分析来评估空间相关性。应用主成分分析（PCA）来计算健康风险指数。结果：医院可及性分布不均。医院较少的服务不足地区的ADRD死亡率更高。热点分析显示，马里兰州东部和南部地区的每人口和每ADRD患者死亡率高，且被类似高比率区域包围。马里兰州中部患者死亡率较低但医疗设施更多。在马里兰州东部，高贫困区被低可及性和高健康风险指数区包围。结论：医院可及性分布不均，造成了主要的农村差异。在医疗设施可及性方面服务不足的地区，特别是马里兰州东部和南部，尽管诊断率低，但ADRD死亡率很高。这表明许多ADRD病例仍未被诊断、诊断不足或治疗延迟。
AI.summary: 本研究旨在调查马里兰州阿尔茨海默病及相关痴呆症（ADRD）密度与医疗保健可及性之间的关系。通过地理空间分析方法（如KD2SFCA和热点分析），分析基于诊断病例和死亡率的服务不足和过度服务的地区。结果显示，医院可及性分布不均，农村和东南部服务不足地区死亡率高但诊断率低，暗示存在大量未诊断或延迟治疗的病例。
AI.keywords: 阿尔茨海默病, 医疗可及性, 地理差异, 死亡率, KD2SFCA
AI.comments: 本研究的创新点在于结合了地理空间分析方法（如KD2SFCA和热点分析）与临床数据（诊断率和死亡率），量化了阿尔茨海默病护理中的地理差异。其重要性在于明确指出了医疗资源分配不均如何导致特定弱势地区（如马里兰州的农村和贫困地区）的死亡率升高和潜在的漏诊问题，为政策制定者提供了干预和改善医疗公平性的明确目标区域。

title: Group Cooperation Diverges onto Durable Low versus High Paths: Public Goods Experiments in 134 Honduran Villages
comments: This is the initial version of the manuscript. The presentation of figures, tables, and analyses may be revised in future versions to better align with the requirements and scope of the target journal
summary: We performed large, lab-in-the-field experiment (2,591 participants across 134 Honduran villages; ten rounds) and tracked how contribution behavior unfolds in fixed, anonymous groups of size five. Contribution separates early into two durable paths, one low and one high, with rare convergence thereafter. High-path players can be identified with strong accuracy early on. Groups that begin with an early majority of above-norm contributors (about 60%) are very likely finish high. The empirical finding of a bifurcation, consistent with the theory, shows that early, high contributions by socially central people steer groups onto, and help keep them on, a high-cooperation path.

AI.title_translation: 群体合作分化为持久的低路径与高路径：对134个洪都拉斯村庄的公共物品实验
AI.tldr: 在洪都拉斯的公共物品实验中，群体合作行为会迅速分化为高低两条稳定路径，早期高贡献（特别是来自核心人物的）决定了群体的长期命运。
AI.motivation: 研究如何追踪固定群体中的贡献行为如何演变，特别是群体合作行为的分化路径。
AI.method: 在134个洪都拉斯村庄中进行了包含2,591名参与者的大型“场内实验室”实验，在固定的、匿名的五人小组中进行了十轮贡献行为追踪。
AI.result: 贡献行为很早地分离成两条持久的路径：一条低路径和一条高路径，之后很少出现收敛。早期有过高贡献的玩家可以被准确识别。早期多数（约60%）高于规范的贡献者会使群体很可能以高水平合作结束。
AI.conclusion: 早期高贡献行为，特别是社会中心人物的贡献，能够引导群体进入并维持在高合作路径上。
AI.translation: 我们在134个洪都拉斯村庄中进行了大型场内实验（2,591名参与者，十轮），追踪了固定、匿名五人小组中贡献行为的演变。贡献行为很早地分离成两条持久的路径，一条低，一条高，此后很少收敛。高路径的参与者可以被很早地准确识别出来。早期有多数（约60%）高于规范的贡献者的群体，极有可能以高合作水平结束。这一与理论一致的实证发现表明，社会中心人物的早期高贡献行为引导并帮助群体维持在高合作路径上。
AI.summary: 这项在洪都拉斯134个村庄进行的包含2591名参与者的大型场内实验发现，在公共物品博弈中，群体的贡献行为会很早地分化为两条持久的高低合作路径，且后期很少收敛。研究表明，早期由社会中心人物主导的高贡献行为，能将群体引导并维持在高合作轨道上。
AI.keywords: 公共物品实验, 合作路径, 路径依赖, 洪都拉斯, 贡献行为
AI.comments: 该研究的创新之处在于其大规模的田野实验设计和对合作路径分叉的实证观察。其重要性在于揭示了社会中心人物的早期贡献行为对群体长期合作轨迹的决定性影响。局限性可能在于实验的文化背景（洪都拉斯村庄）是否具有普遍性。

title: Neural posterior inference with state-space models for calibrating ice sheet simulators
summary: Ice sheet models are routinely used to quantify and project an ice sheet's contribution to sea level rise. In order for an ice sheet model to generate realistic projections, its parameters must first be calibrated using observational data; this is challenging due to the nonlinearity of the model equations, the high dimensionality of the underlying parameters, and limited data availability for validation. This study leverages the emerging field of neural posterior approximation for efficiently calibrating ice sheet model parameters and boundary conditions. We make use of a one-dimensional (flowline) Shallow-Shelf Approximation model in a state-space framework. A neural network is trained to infer the underlying parameters, namely the bedrock elevation and basal friction coefficient along the flowline, based on observations of ice velocity and ice surface elevation. Samples from the approximate posterior distribution of the parameters are then used within an ensemble Kalman filter to infer latent model states, namely the ice thickness along the flowline. We show through a simulation study that our approach yields more accurate estimates of the parameters and states than a state-augmented ensemble Kalman filter, which is the current state-of-the-art. We apply our approach to infer the bed elevation and basal friction along a flowline in Thwaites Glacier, Antarctica.

AI.title_translation: 使用状态空间模型进行神经后验推断以校准冰盖模拟器
AI.tldr: 该研究利用神经后验近似和状态空间模型高效校准冰盖模拟器参数，并在模拟研究中显示出比现有技术更准确的参数和状态估计。
AI.motivation: 冰盖模型用于量化和预测冰盖对海平面上升的贡献，但其参数校准因模型方程的非线性、高维参数和有限的验证数据而具有挑战性。
AI.method: 该研究利用神经后验近似，结合一维（流线）浅架近似模型和状态空间框架。训练一个神经网络，根据冰速和冰面高程观测推断基岩高程和底部摩擦系数等参数。然后，使用来自参数近似后验分布的样本，通过集合卡尔曼滤波器推断冰厚度等潜在模型状态。
AI.result: 模拟研究表明，该方法比现有技术（状态增强集合卡尔曼滤波器）能更准确地估计参数和状态。该方法还应用于推断南极洲思韦茨冰川流线上的基岩高程和底部摩擦。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出了一种结合神经后验推断和状态空间模型的新方法，能够高效且更准确地校准冰盖模拟器参数和状态，优于现有技术，并成功应用于实际冰川数据。
AI.translation: 冰盖模型常用于量化和预测冰盖对海平面上升的贡献。为了使冰盖模型生成真实的预测，其参数必须首先使用观测数据进行校准；由于模型方程的非线性、底层参数的高维性以及有限的验证数据可用性，这具有挑战性。本研究利用新兴的神经后验近似领域来有效校准冰盖模型参数和边界条件。我们使用状态空间框架中的一维（流线）浅架近似模型。训练一个神经网络，根据冰速和冰面高程观测推断底层参数，即沿流线的基岩高程和底部摩擦系数。然后，来自参数近似后验分布的样本在集合卡尔曼滤波器中用于推断潜在模型状态，即沿流线的冰厚度。我们通过模拟研究表明，我们的方法比当前最先进的状态增强集合卡尔曼滤波器能产生更准确的参数和状态估计。我们将我们的方法应用于推断南极洲思韦茨冰川流线上的基岩高程和底部摩擦。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种结合神经后验近似和状态空间模型的新方法，用于高效校准冰盖模拟器的参数和边界条件。该方法利用神经网络从观测数据中推断冰盖参数（如基岩高程和底部摩擦系数），并结合集合卡尔曼滤波器推断潜在模型状态（如冰厚度）。模拟结果表明，该方法在参数和状态估计方面优于现有的状态增强集合卡尔曼滤波器，并成功应用于南极洲思韦茨冰川的实际数据，为冰盖模型校准提供了更准确和高效的工具。
AI.keywords: 冰盖模拟器, 神经后验推断, 状态空间模型, 参数校准, 集合卡尔曼滤波器
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将神经后验近似与状态空间模型相结合，解决了冰盖模型参数校准中长期存在的非线性、高维性和数据稀缺挑战。其超越现有技术（状态增强集合卡尔曼滤波器）的准确性，以及在实际冰川数据上的应用潜力，使其在气候科学和冰川学领域具有重要意义。该方法为未来更复杂的地球系统模型校准提供了新的思路。

title: Bayesian Model Selection with an Application to Cosmology
summary: We investigate cosmological parameter inference and model selection from a Bayesian perspective. Type Ia supernova data from the Dark Energy Survey (DES-SN5YR) are used to test the \(Λ\)CDM, \(w\)CDM, and CPL cosmological models. Posterior inference is performed via Hamiltonian Monte Carlo using the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) implemented in NumPyro and analyzed with ArviZ in Python. Bayesian model comparison is conducted through Bayes factors computed using the \texttt{bridgesampling} library in R. The results indicate that all three models demonstrate similar predictive performance, but \(w\)CDM shows stronger evidence relative to \(Λ\)CDM and CPL. We conclude that, under the assumptions and data used in this study, \(w\)CDM provides a better description of cosmological expansion.

AI.title_translation: 贝叶斯模型选择及其在宇宙学中的应用
AI.tldr: 使用DES-SN5YR数据和先进的贝叶斯采样方法比较了$\Lambda$CDM、$w$CDM和CPL模型，发现$w$CDM模型在贝叶斯证据上略优于其他模型，是当前数据的最佳描述。
AI.motivation: 从贝叶斯角度研究宇宙学参数推断和模型选择。
AI.method: 使用哈密顿蒙特卡洛（HMC）和No-U-Turn采样器（NUTS）进行后验推断，并使用NumPyro实现；使用\texttt{bridgesampling}库计算贝叶斯因子进行模型比较。
AI.result: 所有三个模型（$\Lambda$CDM, $w$CDM, CPL）表现出相似的预测性能，但$w$CDM相对于$\Lambda$CDM和CPL显示出更强的证据。
AI.conclusion: 在当前研究的假设和数据下，$w$CDM模型比$\Lambda$CDM和CPL模型能更好地描述宇宙膨胀。
AI.translation: 我们从贝叶斯角度研究了宇宙学参数推断和模型选择。使用来自暗能量巡天（DES-SN5YR）的Ia型超新星数据来检验$\Lambda$CDM、$w$CDM和CPL宇宙学模型。后验推断通过在NumPyro中实现的哈密顿蒙特卡洛（NUTS）使用No-U-Turn采样器进行，并使用ArviZ在Python中进行分析。贝叶斯模型比较通过使用R中\texttt{bridgesampling}库计算的贝叶斯因子进行。结果表明，所有三个模型都表现出相似的预测性能，但$w$CDM相对于$\Lambda$CDM和CPL显示出更强的证据。我们得出结论，在本次研究的假设和数据下，$w$CDM模型能更好地描述宇宙膨胀。
AI.summary: 本研究采用贝叶斯方法，利用DES-SN5YR的Ia型超新星数据，通过HMC/NUTS和贝叶斯因子比较了$\Lambda$CDM、$w$CDM和CPL三种宇宙学模型。结果显示$w$CDM模型相对于其他模型具有更强的证据支持，表明其对宇宙膨胀的描述更优。
AI.keywords: 贝叶斯模型选择, 宇宙学参数推断, Type Ia 超新星, $w$CDM, 贝叶斯因子
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于结合了先进的贝叶斯推断工具（HMC/NUTS、NumPyro、ArviZ、bridgesampling）来对宇宙学模型进行严格的选择。重要性在于它为当前主流的宇宙学模型（$\Lambda$CDM, $w$CDM, CPL）提供了基于最新DES-SN5YR数据的贝叶斯模型证据。局限性可能在于结果依赖于所选模型集合和特定数据集的质量。

title: Network Meta Analysis of Mean Survival
summary: Decisions based upon pairwise comparisons of multiple treatments are naturally performed in terms of the mean survival of the selected study arms or functions thereof. However, synthesis of treatment comparisons is usually performed on surrogates of the mean survival, such as hazard ratios or restricted mean survival times. Thus, network meta-analysis techniques may suffer from the limitations of these approaches, such as incorrect proportional hazards assumption or short-term follow-up periods. We propose a Bayesian framework for the network meta-analysis of the main outcome informing the decision, the mean survival of a treatment. Its derivation involves extrapolation of the observed survival curves. We use methods for stable extrapolation that integrate long term evidence based upon mortality projections. Extrapolations are performed using flexible poly-hazard parametric models and M-spline-based methods. We assess the computational and statistical efficiency of different techniques using a simulation study and apply the developed methods to two real data sets. The proposed method is formulated within a decision theoretic framework for cost-effectiveness analyses, where the `best' treatment is to be selected and incorporating the associated cost information is straightforward.

title: IntegralGP: Volumetric estimation of subterranean geochemical properties in mineral deposits by fusing assay data with different spatial supports
comments: Keywords: Heteroscedastic Gaussian processes, IntegralGP covariance functions, volumetric regression, heterogeneous spatial supports, data fusion, ore grade estimation
summary: This article presents an Integral Gaussian Process (IntegralGP) framework for volumetric estimation of subterranean properties in mineral deposits. It provides a unified representation for data with different spatial supports, which enables blasthole geochemical assays to be properly modelled as interval observations rather than points. This approach is shown to improve regression performance and boundary delineation. A core contribution is a description of the mathematical changes to the covariance expressions which allow these benefits to be realised. The gradient and anti-derivatives are obtained to facilitate learning of the kernel hyperparameters. Numerical stability issues are also discussed. To illustrate its application, an IntegralGP data fusion algorithm is described. The objective is to assimilate line-based blasthole assays and update a block model that provides long-range prediction of Fe concentration beneath the drilled bench. Heteroscedastic GP is used to fuse chemically compatible but spatially incongruous data with different resolutions and sample spacings. Domain knowledge embodied in the structure and empirical distribution of the block model must be generally preserved while local inaccuracies are corrected. Using validation measurements within the predicted bench, our experiments demonstrate an improvement in bench-below grade prediction performance. For material classification, IntegralGP fusion reduces the absolute error and model bias in categorical prediction, especially instances where waste blocks are mistakenly classified as high-grade.
